units.source_text: 源氏大将说：“此间乃神圣之地，但只在廊下，想必无妨？”

en.t: General Genji said, "This is sacred ground, but if I stay only on the veranda, surely there can be no harm?"
Then he stepped up onto the veranda and sat down.

units.source_text: 此时月光清丽，照见源氏大将态度动作之优雅，无可比喻。

en.t: At that moment the moonlight was clear and lovely, revealing General Genji's incomparable grace in bearing and movement.

units.source_text: 源氏大将和她久不相见，要把几月来积压在胸中的情愫悉数道出，似觉无从说起。

en.t: General Genji had not seen her for a long time, and though he wanted to pour out all the feelings that had built up in his heart over the past months, he seemed not to know where to begin.

units.source_text: 便把手中折得的杨桐一小枝塞进帘内，开言道：“我心不变，正似此杨桐之常青。

en.t: So he pushed a small branch of evergreen spindle tree that he had broken off in his hand inside the curtain and began, "My heart is unchanged, just like the enduring green of this tree.

units.source_text: 全赖有此毅力，今日不顾禁忌，擅越神垣，前来奉访。

en.t: It is only by relying on such steadfastness that today I have ignored the taboo, crossed the sacred fence without leave, and come to pay you this visit.
Yet unexpectedly, I am still received so coldly..."
